shell.impersonationWarning: This session was opened by the support team on behalf of a user. Every action is additionally recorded.
shell.searchPlaceholder: Search pages or start an action…

login.title: Sign in
login.identifierHint: Enter an email to receive a sign-in link, or a phone number to receive an SMS code.
login.magicLinkHint: Just click the link in the email; you don't need to enter a code.
login.consentNote: By signing in you accept the <kvkk>Privacy Notice</kvkk> and the terms of use.
login.emailSent: A sign-in link has been sent to your email. It is valid for 15 minutes.
login.smsSent: A verification code has been sent to your phone. It is valid for 5 minutes.
login.invalidIdentifier: Enter a valid email address or mobile number.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
login.smsBody: Your {brand} sign-in code: {code}. Do not share it with anyone.

tokenError.used: This code has already been used.
tokenError.wrongPurpose: The code is not valid for this action.

dashboard.description: Your property's current financial and operational status.
dashboard.trialBody: All modules are enabled. No charge is made automatically when the trial ends; your account is suspended and your data is kept for {months} months.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Once units are added you can create a dues plan and invite residents.
dashboard.emptyStep1: Create the block and unit list (bulk create or Excel).
dashboard.emptyStep2: Define the dues plan (equal, land share or mixed).
dashboard.chartIncomeExpenseHint: Last 12 months. All three share the same unit (kuruş), so they compare on one axis.
dashboard.chartCollectionRateHint: Monthly collections over that month's accruals. Months above 100% mean older debts were settled.
dashboard.chartAgingHint: Overdue balance grouped by how long it has been due. Amounts past 90 days are the threshold for enforcement.
dashboard.chartForecastHint: The dashed line is a forecast: upcoming due amounts are multiplied by the realised collection rate of the last 6 months ({rate}), and expenses are assumed at the 6-month average. No model or AI involved.
dashboard.chartSplitHint: All charge records split into paid, not yet due and overdue.
dashboard.chartMixHint: Each month's accrual stacked as collected and not collected. A thickening upper band means arrears are growing.
dashboard.chartFlowHint: Expenses are subtracted from collections to reach net. Each bar starts where the previous one ended.
dashboard.chartTargetHint: Collection rate of the last three months against the target line. A bar past the line means the month met the target.

units.title: Units
units.summary: {units} units · {blocks} blocks · {area} m² total · land share total {share}
units.landShareWarning: Land shares don't add up to 1 (or 1000). Land-share billing distributes proportionally, but we recommend checking against the title deed records.
units.emptyDescription: Create units quickly; land share and floor area feed the dues formulas.
units.emptyStep1: Define the blocks (skip for single-block buildings).
units.emptyStep2: Enter the unit count to generate them, or upload an Excel file.
units.emptyStep3: Complete the land share and m² details.
units.newUnitDescription: Add a single flat, shop or storage unit. Use the wizard for block-wide bulk creation.
units.editUnitDescription: Update the number, land share, area and dues settings. Changes apply from the next charge run onwards.
units.bulkWizardDescription: Create every unit in a block from the floor range and units per floor in one step.
units.manageBlocksDescription: Edit block name, floor count, lift availability and ordering.
units.deleteDescription: Records stay in the trash for 30 days and can be restored. Charge and payment history is kept.
units.createFailed: The unit could not be created.
units.numberTaken: Number {number} is already used in this block.
units.bulkCreatedWithSkips: {created} units created; {skipped} skipped because they already existed.
units.bulkTooMany: At most {max} units can be created at once. Narrow the floor range.
units.floorRangeInvalid: The last floor cannot be lower than the first floor.
units.blockRequired: Select an existing block or enter a new block name.
units.blockNotFound: The selected block was not found.
units.sectionIdentityHint: Door number and the block the unit belongs to.
units.numberHint: Door number or code (e.g. 3, A-12, D5).
units.blockHint: Leave empty if there are no blocks; you can assign one later.
units.sectionMeasuresHint: Dues formulas read these values; required for area or land-share distribution.
units.shareFractionHint: The form used on the title deed (e.g. 120/1000).
units.shareDecimalRange: Between 0 and 1, up to six decimals.
units.sectionOccupancyHint: Owner/tenant relations are created with resident records; this is the summary state.
units.sectionDuesHint: Exemptions and the multiplier apply to this unit only.
units.duesExemptHint: No charges are generated for vacant-unit decisions or manager exemptions.
units.lateFeeExemptHint: No late fee accrues on instalment plans or charges under litigation.
units.duesMultiplierHint: 1.000 = standard. Shops may use a coefficient such as 1.500.
units.duesMultiplierNote: The multiplier also drives increases: a 10% rise means multiplying it by 1.100. That keeps every increase recorded in one place.
units.notesHint: Visible to management only; never shown to residents.
units.noOccupants: No residents recorded for this unit.
units.occupancyHistoryHint: Former owners and tenants are listed too; relation history is never deleted.
units.noDebts: No charges recorded for this unit.
units.metersHint: Meter readings are entered from the Meters module.
units.noDocuments: No documents linked to this unit.
units.bulkSectionBlockHint: Add to an existing block or create a new one.
units.newBlockNameHint: Leave empty if you selected an existing block.
units.bulkSectionLayoutHint: Floor range and units per floor.
units.numberingFloorPrefixedHint: Numbers are built from floor + sequence.
units.numberingSequentialHint: Numbers increase from start to end.
units.bulkSectionDefaultsHint: Applied to every generated unit; editable one by one afterwards.
units.bulkAreaHint: Enter it if all units share the same area; otherwise leave empty and edit later.
units.bulkShareHint: If you enter a denominator, the numerator is split equally across units.
units.blockFormHint: Block names must be unique within the property.
units.blockNotEmpty: This block still has {count} units. Move or delete them first.
units.deleteBlockDescription: Deletion is blocked while the block still contains units.
units.bulkPreviewReady: Preview ready: {count} units will be created. Review the list and confirm.
units.bulkPreviewHint: This list was generated on the server; these are exactly the numbers that will be saved.
units.drawerCreatedHint: You can continue here — the list stayed open behind this panel.
units.drawerAddResident: Add a resident to this unit

residents.title: Residents
residents.description: Contact details are masked for data-protection reasons; opening a record reveals them and the access is logged.
residents.privacyNotice: Debt information may not be shared on community channels. Use the “Send message” flow on the resident card for individual notices.
residents.emptyDescription: Invite residents by SMS or WhatsApp; they confirm their own details from the invitation.
residents.emptyStep2: Enter owner/tenant details or upload an Excel file.
residents.emptyStep3: Send bulk invitations — residents give their own consent.
residents.newResidentDescription: Add an owner or tenant. The same person may hold several units; one record is created and their balances roll up into a single account.
residents.editResidentDescription: Update identity, contact and emergency details. Unit relationships are managed from the resident detail page.
residents.searchPlaceholder: Search name, phone, e-mail or unit…
residents.tcknHint: Stored encrypted; only a masked value is ever displayed.
residents.tcknEditHint: The stored value is masked. Leave empty to keep it unchanged.
residents.localeHint: Notifications are sent in this language.
residents.removeTitle: Remove the selected residents from this property?
residents.removeDescription: The person's user account is kept (they may belong to other properties); only their membership and open unit relations here are closed. Residents with unpaid balances are skipped.
residents.sectionIdentityHint: Name is required; enter the national ID only when needed (data minimisation).
residents.sectionContactHint: Phone or e-mail is required — otherwise no charge notice can be delivered.
residents.phoneHint: Pick the country code for international numbers.
residents.whatsappOptInHint: The consent record is stored with its date and document version; the resident may withdraw it at any time.
residents.sectionEmergencyHint: Who to call in case of fire, flooding and similar events.
residents.sectionFirstUnitHint: Link the resident to a unit now, or add relations later.
residents.relationOwnerHint: Registered as owner on the title deed.
residents.relationTenantHint: Occupies the unit under a lease.
residents.relationNoneHint: Only the person record is created.
residents.relationNoneNotice: Charges cannot be assigned without a unit relation. You can link one from the detail page after saving.
residents.startDateHint: Title transfer or lease start date.
residents.ownershipPctHint: Share of joint ownership (%). Leave 100 for a sole owner.
residents.debtTransferPolicyHint: Determines who inherits the remaining balance when a tenant leaves.
residents.notesHint: Visible to management only; never shown to the resident.
residents.kvkkLabel: The privacy notice was delivered to the resident and consent obtained
residents.kvkkDescription: The duty to inform (KVKK art. 10) is mandatory before processing personal data. Consent is recorded with its date and document version.
residents.kvkkRequired: A resident cannot be created without privacy-notice consent.
residents.contactRequired: Either a phone number or an e-mail address is required.
residents.linkedExisting: {name} was already registered and has been linked to this site.
residents.createFailed: The resident record could not be created.
residents.notInTenant: This person is not registered in this property.
residents.bulkRemovedPartial: {count} residents removed; {skipped} skipped because of unpaid balances.
residents.occupancyExists: This person already has an open relation of the same kind for this unit.
residents.noActiveOwner: This unit has no active owner, so the balance cannot be transferred. Add an owner first.
residents.occupancyEnded: Relation closed; charges stayed with the person.
residents.occupancyEndedTransferred: Relation closed; {count} charges transferred to the owner.
residents.occupancyEndedPending: Relation closed; charges flagged for transfer to the next tenant.
residents.unitsSummaryHint: The balance is the sum of open charges for that unit.
residents.noUnits: This person has no unit relations.
residents.occupancyHint: Past relations are listed too; records are closed, never deleted.
residents.addOccupancyHint: Link the resident to a unit as owner or tenant.
residents.endOccupancyHint: Enter the departure date and choose who inherits the remaining balance. The decision is written to the audit log.
residents.endOccupancyDebtWarning: This unit has an unpaid balance. Your transfer choice changes who owes it.
residents.transferReasonHint: A short note such as lease end or title transfer. Shown in the audit record.
residents.debtsHint: Every charge this person owes — one account across all units.
residents.paymentsHint: Payments made by this person. Payments on someone else's behalf are flagged.
residents.kvkkHint: Privacy notice and explicit consent records; each change is appended, history is never deleted.
residents.drawerCreatedHint: You can continue here — the list stayed open behind this panel.
residents.bloodTypeHint: Special category health data (KVKK art. 6) — stored only with explicit consent.
residents.healthConsentLabel: The resident gave explicit consent to process their blood type for emergency purposes.
residents.healthConsentDescription: Under KVKK art. 6/3 health data may only be processed with explicit consent. If unchecked, the blood type is not saved; clearing the field counts as withdrawing consent and deletes the data.
residents.healthConsentRequired: Explicit consent must be checked to save a blood type.
residents.emergencyDescription: Blood types and emergency contacts — for use during fire, earthquake and medical incidents.
residents.emergencyPrivacyNotice: This screen shows special category health data and unmasked phone numbers. Every view is separately written to the KVKK access log. Keep printouts where only authorised staff can reach them.
residents.emergencyTableHint: Blood type is filled in only for residents who gave explicit consent.
residents.statMissingBothHint: Neither blood type nor emergency contact on file.

duesPlans.title: Dues plans
duesPlans.description: Debt generation is idempotent: the same period is never accrued twice.
duesPlans.dueDaySuffix: due on day {day} of each month
duesPlans.transparencyBody: When a dues amount or due date changes, the change is written to an immutable record that residents can view.
duesPlans.emptyDescription: Once a plan exists, debts are generated automatically at 03:00 on the 1st of each month.
duesPlans.emptyStep2: Choose the billing formula (equal, land share, m², meter, mixed).
duesPlans.emptyStep3: Set the due day; reminders are sent automatically.
duesPlans.newPlanDescription: Define the template for recurring charges: period, formula, due day and late-fee rate.
duesPlans.sectionBasicsHint: The plan name and the periods it covers.
duesPlans.dueDayHint: Day of the month payment is due (1–28).
duesPlans.periodRangeInvalid: The end period cannot precede the start period.
duesPlans.sectionFormulaHint: Exempt units receive nothing; their share is not redistributed.
duesPlans.formulaEqualHint: The same amount per unit (the unit multiplier applies).
duesPlans.formulaLandShareHint: By the land share on the title deed.
duesPlans.formulaMixedHint: Partly equal, the rest by land share.
duesPlans.meterNotice: The meter formula needs period readings. Remember to enter them from the Meters module.
duesPlans.baseAmountHint: The amount charged to each unit.
duesPlans.totalAmountHint: This amount is split across units by the formula.
duesPlans.mixEqualPctHint: The remainder is distributed by land share. e.g. 50 → half equal, half land share.
duesPlans.sectionLateFeeHint: The rate that accrues after the due date.
duesPlans.lateFeePctHint: KMK art. 20 caps this at 5% per month; higher values are rejected.
duesPlans.lateFeeDailyHint: When on, the monthly rate is divided by 30 and accrues per day. Paying on the 2nd is no longer the same as paying on the 29th.
duesPlans.lateFeeLegalNotice: When an interim payment is recorded, the fee is recalculated on the remaining balance, preventing unjust accrual.
duesPlans.blockScopeHint: Leave empty to include all blocks.
duesPlans.unitTypeScopeHint: Leave empty to include all unit types.
duesPlans.isActiveHint: Inactive plans do not run at period start but keep their history.
duesPlans.saveFailed: The plan could not be saved.
duesPlans.archived: Plan archived. Charges generated from it are kept.
duesPlans.runDescription: Generate this plan's debts without waiting for next month.
duesPlans.runHint: Preview first: see how many debts and what total would be generated, then apply. The same period is never generated twice.
duesPlans.runPreview: Preview: {count} debts, {total} ₺ total. Nothing has been written yet.
duesPlans.runSkipped: No debts were generated for this period.
duesPlans.runFellBackToEqual: The chosen formula could not be applied and equal distribution was used instead. This usually means land share, area or occupant count is missing — check the unit records.
duesPlans.bulkFromPlanDescription: Carry the plan's settings into the wizard for a one-off charge.
duesPlans.bulkFromPlanNotice: The wizard **copies** the plan's formula, amount, due day and scope — it does not link to the plan. The debts it creates are independent of the plan's periodic run; for periodic generation use the "run now" box above.
duesPlans.bulkFromPlanAction: Prefill the bulk debt wizard from this plan

debts.title: Debts & collection
debts.description: Current balance per unit. Late fees are recalculated daily (Condominium Act art. 20).
debts.overdueAlertBody: {amount} of receivables is overdue. Cases older than {days} days are listed in the Legal & Enforcement module.
debts.emptyMessage: No debt records yet. Once a dues plan exists, accruals are created automatically on the 1st of each month.
debts.newDebtDescription: Create a charge for a single unit. Use the bulk wizard to charge many units at once.
debts.bulkWizardDescription: Charge many units at once using a distribution formula. A preview is required before saving.
debts.unitViewHint: Each row is a unit; the balance is the sum of its open charges.
debts.lateFeeNotice: Under KMK art. 20 the late fee may not exceed {pct}% per month. Exempt charges carry a shield icon in the list.
debts.changedTooltip: The amount or due date of this charge was changed
debts.cancelDescription: Charges with any payment applied cannot be cancelled and are skipped. The cancellation and its reason are written to the audit log.
debts.bulkReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Board resolution: no dues will be charged for this period
debts.reasonTooShort: The reason must be at least 10 characters.
debts.bulkCancelledPartial: {count} charges cancelled; {skipped} skipped because payments were applied.
debts.exemptRemoved: Late fees will accrue again on {count} charges.
debts.sectionTargetHint: Which unit is charged, and under which line item.
debts.descriptionHint: This text appears in the resident's notice. Be explicit: "May 2026 dues".
debts.sectionAmountHint: With instalments the amount is split evenly and due dates advance month by month.
debts.periodHint: Accounting period. Duplicate-charge checks use it.
debts.installmentHint: 1 = one-off. Late fees are disabled automatically for instalments.
debts.installmentPreview: Will be created as {count} instalments × {amount} ₺, advancing monthly.
debts.sectionShareHint: This choice determines the accounts; changing it later requires a debt transfer.
debts.shareTenantHint: Usage-driven items such as water, fuel, cleaning.
debts.shareSplitHint: Two separate charges are created, each on its own account.
debts.shareByShareHint: Split by share percentage for jointly owned units.
debts.lateFeeExemptFormHint: When on, no late fee accrues on this charge.
debts.nothingToCreate: No charge to create. Check the amount and target selection.
debts.noTenant: This unit has no registered tenant. Add one, or charge the owner instead.
debts.splitNeedsBoth: Splitting half and half requires both an owner and a tenant on the unit.
debts.sectionWhatHint: The description appears in the resident's notice.
debts.dueDayHint: Day of the month payment is due (1–28).
debts.sectionFormulaHint: How the amount is split. Exempt units receive nothing and their share is not redistributed.
debts.formulaEqualHint: The same amount per unit (the unit multiplier applies).
debts.formulaLandShareHint: By the land share on the title deed.
debts.formulaPersonHint: By the number of occupants (water, waste).
debts.amountPerUnitHint: This amount is charged to every unit.
debts.amountPoolHint: This amount is split across units by the formula.
debts.sectionScopeHint: Selecting no block includes every unit.
debts.blockScopeHint: Leave empty to include all blocks.
debts.skipExisting: Skip units already charged for this period
debts.skipExistingHint: Prevents duplicates when the wizard is run twice. Turning this off is not recommended.
debts.bulkLateFeeExemptHint: No late fee will accrue on this batch.
debts.previewHint: The amounts shown are the amounts that will be saved — the same calculation is used.
debts.previewSkipped: {count} units will be skipped as they already have a charge for this period.
debts.previewInvalid: Complete the form to see a preview.
debts.overdueNotice: This charge is {days} days overdue. Unless exempt, late fees keep accruing.
debts.timelineHint: Amount and due-date changes are recorded immutably and residents see the same entries. This makes silent retroactive increases impossible.
debts.timelineEmpty: This charge has not been changed yet.
debts.debtorUnassignedNotice: This charge has no liable party; the unit has no registered owner or tenant. Assign it once a resident is added.
debts.installmentPlanHint: All instalments of the same plan.
debts.adjustHint: The change is recorded permanently together with its reason.
debts.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Clear enough to answer the resident's "why did this change?".
debts.reasonWarning: This reason is visible in the resident's charge detail. It cannot be deleted.
debts.visibleHint: Turn off only for internal corrections (typos); the transparency principle favours leaving it on.
debts.paidWarning: This charge has payments applied. The new amount cannot fall below the paid amount.
debts.belowPaid: The new amount cannot be below the amount already paid.
debts.adjusted: Charge updated and written to the change history.
debts.collectHint: The amount is applied starting from the oldest due date; within each charge the late fee is settled first.
debts.payerHint: Select when someone other than the liable party paid; the receipt marks it "on behalf".
debts.targetDebtsHint: Leave empty to start from the oldest due date.
debts.collectedWithCredit: Payment recorded. {credit} ₺ exceeded the charges and remains as a credit balance.
debts.collectFailed: The payment could not be recorded.
debts.noOpenDebts: This unit has no open charges.
debts.trendLabel: Balance trend of unit {unit} over the last {months} months
debts.bankAccountHint: So reconciliation can answer "which statement should show this payment". Optional.
debts.noBankAccounts: No bank account is defined. Define one on the Bank & Reconciliation page to also record which account a collection went into.
debts.drawerCreatedHint: The list has been updated. You can enter a debt for another unit or open the detail.
debts.presetBody: The formula, amount, due day and scope were copied from the plan; you can change all of them. This charge is **not linked** to the plan — it creates a one-off record independent of the plan's periodic run.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.emptyDescription: Upload invoices; category reports and budget comparisons are generated automatically.
expenses.emptyStep1: Review the expense categories (a default list is preloaded).
expenses.emptyStep2: Upload the invoice; VAT is separated automatically.
expenses.emptyStep3: Bill the shareable expenses to residents using a distribution formula.
expenses.newExpenseDescription: Record an invoice or payment. The category determines the formula used to pass it on to units.
expenses.searchPlaceholder: Search description, vendor or invoice no…
expenses.categorySelectHint: If no category exists, define one from the Categories screen first.
expenses.categoryDistributionNotice: Default distribution for this category: {formula}. It can be changed at distribution time.
expenses.statUndistributedHint: Approved but not yet passed on to residents
expenses.noCategoriesBody: Without a category the distribution formula is undefined. Define at least one from the Categories screen.
expenses.sectionWhatHint: What it was paid for and which category it belongs to.
expenses.sectionAmountHint: Enter the VAT-inclusive amount; VAT is derived from the rate.
expenses.amountGrossHint: The total paid on the invoice.
expenses.vatRateFormHint: The category default is selected automatically.
expenses.withholdingHint: Tax withheld on payroll and rent expenses.
expenses.sectionPaymentHint: Mark it if already paid; with approval rights you can save it approved directly.
expenses.paidViaHint: Bank, cash, card and so on.
expenses.isPaidHint: When on, the expense date is recorded as the payment date.
expenses.attachmentUrlHint: A link can be entered until file hosting is enabled.
expenses.uploadHint: PNG, JPG or PDF · max 10 MB
expenses.uploadTooLarge: The file exceeds the 10 MB limit.
expenses.deleteDescription: Distributed expenses cannot be deleted and are skipped; resident charges exist against them.
expenses.notDistributedTooltip: Not yet passed on to residents
expenses.saveFailed: The expense could not be saved.
expenses.bulkDeletedPartial: {count} expenses deleted; {skipped} skipped because they were already distributed.
expenses.alreadyDistributedEdit: A distributed expense cannot be edited
expenses.alreadyDistributedEditHint: This expense has been passed on to residents as charges. To correct it you must cancel those charges first; otherwise the expense and the charges will disagree.
expenses.categoriesDescription: A two-level category tree. Each category carries its own distribution formula, which expense records inherit.
expenses.categoriesEmpty: No categories defined yet. Start by adding the first one.
expenses.categoryFormHint: Names must be unique within the property.
expenses.distributionHint: How expenses in this category are split across units.
expenses.isSharedHint: When off, the expense is specific to one unit or block and is excluded from general distribution.
expenses.iconHint: A Lucide icon name (e.g. Wrench). Unknown names are ignored.
expenses.categoryActiveHint: Inactive categories are hidden on new expense forms but still read on old records.
expenses.categorySaveFailed: The category could not be saved.
expenses.categoryDeactivated: Category deactivated. It was not deleted because {count} expense records reference it.
expenses.archiveCategoryDescription: No expenses reference this category; it will be archived.
expenses.archiveCategoryInUse: Expense records reference this category. It will be deactivated instead of deleted so past reports stay intact.
expenses.depthLimit: The category tree may be at most two levels deep.
expenses.selfParent: A category cannot be its own parent.
expenses.pendingApprovalNotice: This expense awaits approval. It must be approved before it can be passed on to units.
expenses.generatedDebtsHint: Unit charges created by the distribution.
expenses.noGeneratedDebts: This expense has not been passed on to units yet.
expenses.distributeHint: The expense is split by the chosen formula and written to units as charges.
expenses.distributeIrreversible: This cannot be undone: charges are written to units and the expense can never be distributed again. Check the preview before saving.
expenses.distributePeriodHint: The accounting period the charges belong to.
expenses.distributeScopeHint: Selecting no block includes every unit.
expenses.dueDayHint: Day of the month payment is due (1–28).
expenses.excludeVatHint: When on, only the net amount is split across units; VAT stays with management.
expenses.alreadyDistributed: This expense is already distributed. The same expense cannot be passed on twice.
expenses.notApprovedYet: Only approved or paid expenses can be distributed.
expenses.nothingToDistribute: No amount or target unit to distribute.
expenses.formulaFellBack: Data is missing for the chosen formula (land share / area / occupant count not entered). The distribution will fall back to equal shares.
expenses.drawerCreatedHint: You can continue here — the list stayed open behind this panel.

bank.title: Bank & reconciliation
bank.description: Several providers can be configured; if one stops responding another takes over. Differences go to the reconciliation queue.
bank.emptyDescription: Connect open banking or upload the bank statement as CSV.
bank.emptyStep2: Connect an open banking provider (or upload a CSV).
bank.emptyStep3: Incoming transfers are matched to units automatically.

issue.missing_in_bank: A payment marked collected in the system hasn't reached the bank account
issue.missing_in_system: Money arrived at the bank but no matching payment exists in the system (may be a transfer)
issue.amount_mismatch: The payment amount differs from the bank transaction (may be a commission deduction)
issue.duplicate: The same payment appears to have been recorded more than once

reason.knownIban: A payment was previously received from the same IBAN
reason.exactAmount: The amount equals the full outstanding balance
reason.closeAmount: The amount is very close to the outstanding balance

bank.newAccountDescription: Define the building's bank account. Without one, transactions and reconciliation stay empty.
bank.editAccountDescription: The IBAN must be re-entered: read endpoints only ever return the masked copy.
bank.accountSectionHint: The IBAN is stored encrypted; only the masked form is shown on screen.
bank.accountNameHint: The account holder name as it appears on the statement. Used as a matching hint.
bank.ibanHint: The check digits are validated. A wrong IBAN means transfers to that account never match.
bank.ibanReentryNotice: Stored IBAN: {iban}. Because the system never sends the full IBAN to any screen, you need to re-enter it when editing — saving a field pre-filled with the mask would write the mask over the real IBAN.
bank.purposeHint: For reconciliation: searching a dues transfer and an equipment-account transfer in the same pool produced false matches.
bank.accountActiveHint: If turned off it cannot be selected on the collection form; past records are kept.
bank.accountHasPayments: There are payment records linked to this account. Removing it keeps the records but the account can no longer be selected for new collections.
bank.accountsTitleHint: The account selector on the collection form is fed from this list.
bank.noAccountsDescription: Without an account, bank transactions cannot be imported, reconciliation does not run, and a collection cannot record which account the money went into.

simulator.title: Budget simulator
simulator.description: Answers “what happens if I raise dues by 20%?” with a 12-month cash-flow projection. The calculation is fully deterministic; no AI is used.
simulator.cashFlowDescription: Estimated collection rate: {rate}% (including the effect of the increase)

warning.deficit: The balance goes negative in {month}. You need an increase of at least {pct}% or lower expenses.
warning.largeIncrease: The dues increase exceeds 50%. A general assembly decision and advance notice (Condominium Act art. 20) are recommended; a sudden increase lowers the collection rate.
warning.lowCollection: Estimated collection rate is {pct}%. Enabling arrears tracking and reminder automation is recommended.
warning.spreadExtra: Spreading one-off expenses over several months can ease cash flow.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Every announcement passes a data-protection filter before sending; texts containing individual debt information are blocked.
announcements.composerDescription: The text is checked automatically before sending.
announcements.bodyHint: Do not write debt information together with a name or unit number; the system will block it.
announcements.bodyPlaceholder: Water will be cut off tomorrow between 09:00 and 14:00 due to mains maintenance.
announcements.urgentDescription: sent on every channel, ignoring quiet hours.
announcements.blockedMessage: The announcement was blocked by the privacy filter. Texts containing individual debt, identity or health information cannot be sent to the community. Fix the findings below or use the individual notice flow.
announcements.publishedMessage: The announcement was published and queued for {channels}.
announcements.draftMessage: The announcement was saved as a draft.
announcements.titleTooShort: The title must be at least 3 characters.
announcements.bodyTooShort: The content must be at least 10 characters.

polls.title: Polls & voting
polls.description: Vote weight can be equal or by land share; decision thresholds are evaluated automatically under the Condominium Act.
polls.emptyDescription: Put decisions to a vote; the result can be added to the decision book as a PDF.
polls.emptyStep1: Write the question and the options.
polls.emptyStep2: Choose the vote weight (equal or land share).
polls.emptyStep3: Choose the required threshold; the system evaluates the result accordingly.
polls.newPollDescription: Open a vote. Under Condominium Act art. 31 the right to vote belongs to the owner; the defaults preserve that.
polls.editPollDescription: Polls that are not closed can be edited. Option order is preserved — append rather than insert.
polls.needTwoOptions: At least two options are required. A poll with one option is not a poll.
polls.closedWithResult: Poll closed. {votes} votes counted, the required majority was reached.
polls.closedNoQuorum: Poll closed. {votes} votes counted but the required majority was not reached.
polls.closedCannotEdit: This poll is closed and its result has been stored. Changing the question or options would leave the stored result describing nothing — hence it cannot be edited.
polls.questionSectionHint: The question residents will see and its explanation.
polls.question: Question
polls.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Should the roof insulation quote be accepted?
polls.descriptionFieldHint: Quote amount, alternatives, timeline — whatever the decision needs.
polls.optionsSectionHint: At least two options are required.
polls.optionsSectionEditHint: Order matters: the option in each position keeps its identifier and existing votes are attached to it. Append rather than insert.
polls.rulesSectionHint: The majority rule and weighting decide how the result is computed.
polls.weightModeHint: Condominium Act art. 31: each unit is one vote. Land-share weighting applies only if the management plan says so.
polls.quorumRuleHint: The majority required for the decision to stand.
polls.quorumNoticeAttendees: Under this rule the majority is measured against **those who voted**.
polls.quorumNoticeAll: Under this rule the majority is measured against **all owners**; an owner who does not vote effectively counts as a "no".
polls.ownersOnlyHint: Turning this off lets tenants vote too. The Act gives the vote to the owner; turning it off should rest on the management plan.
polls.allowMultipleHint: Leave off if a single decision is to be made.
polls.scheduleSectionHint: The poll stays open for this period.
polls.closeReasonHint: If you close before the end date, the reason is recorded in the audit log.
polls.closeWarning: Closing cannot be undone: the result is computed, stored and never changes.

meetings.title: Meetings & decision book
meetings.description: Meeting quorum follows Condominium Act art. 30 and decision thresholds art. 32. A second meeting can decide with those present.
meetings.emptyDescription: An ordinary general assembly must be held at least once a year (Condominium Act art. 29).
meetings.emptyStep1: Enter the date, venue and agenda items.
meetings.emptyStep2: Send invitations automatically 15, 7 and 1 day before.
meetings.emptyStep3: Create the minutes afterwards and add them to the decision book.
meetings.newMeetingDescription: Schedule an ordinary or extraordinary meeting. The agenda order is preserved in the minutes.
meetings.editMeetingDescription: Meeting details and minute decisions. The decision book is a separate module.
meetings.whenSectionHint: What goes into the notice of meeting.
meetings.secondCallAtHint: Applies if the first meeting fails to reach quorum.
meetings.secondCallNotice: Condominium Act art. 30: if the first meeting fails to reach quorum the second may be held no earlier than seven days later. The date is not filled in automatically — a statutory minimum is not a default, and you choose the date that goes into the notice.
meetings.agendaSectionHint: The order is preserved and items are numbered accordingly in the minutes.
meetings.decisionBodyHint: The full text of the decision, as written in the minutes.
meetings.decisionBookNotice: This is a minute decision and can be corrected. For the building-wide, continuously numbered, immutable ledger use the Decision Book module (Condominium Act art. 32).
meetings.ledgerPageNoHint: To match the physical decision book.
meetings.passedHint: Tick if the required majority was reached.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The WhatsApp bot detects intent with a rule engine; messages it cannot understand land here.
messages.emptyDescription: Once a WhatsApp number is connected, resident messages appear here.
messages.emptyStep1: Enter your Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials.
messages.newMessageDescription: Send a message to a single resident. Unlike an announcement, it goes to one person rather than a crowd.

blocked.no_phone: Could not send: this resident has no phone number on record. The record was still created.
blocked.opted_out: Could not send: the resident has opted out of notifications. The record was still created.
blocked.window_closed: Could not send: the WhatsApp 24-hour service window is closed. You can send free text after the resident writes to you; use SMS if it is urgent.
blocked.send_failed: Could not send. The record was created; check the channel settings.

channelNotice.whatsapp: On WhatsApp, free text can only be sent if the resident wrote to you in the last 24 hours (Meta rule). If the window is closed the message is not sent and you are told — saying "sent" for something that never arrived would be the most expensive wrong information this screen could give.
channelNotice.sms: SMS always goes through but costs money and has a character limit.
channelNotice.in_app: Visible only inside the app; the resident will not see it unless they open the app.

messages.bodyPlaceholder: Text to send to the resident…

requests.title: Requests & faults
requests.subject: Subject
requests.emptyDescription: Residents can report a fault by writing “talep” on WhatsApp or through the portal.
requests.emptyStep1: Enable the WhatsApp integration in settings.
requests.emptyStep2: Review the categories and SLA targets.
requests.newRequestDescription: Log a fault, complaint or request from a resident. The code and SLA due date are generated automatically.
requests.detailDescription: Status, assignment and correspondence in one place. Timestamps come from transitions, not manual entry.
requests.sectionWhatHint: Subject and category decide how this request is grouped in lists and reports.
requests.sectionHandlingHint: Priority sets the SLA due date, which is calculated on the server.
requests.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. Block A lift floor button not working
requests.unitHint: Leave empty for a common-area fault.
requests.descriptionFieldHint: What happened, when it was noticed, what has been tried.
requests.assigneeHint: Assigning moves the status to "Assigned" automatically.
requests.costHint: What the work costs the management; can be entered later.
requests.slaPromise: Resolution time promised at this priority: {hours} hours. The clock starts when the request is opened.
requests.slaBreachedBody: This request was not resolved within the promised time. Raising the priority does not push the due date out — the clock keeps running from the opening time.
requests.resolutionNoteHint: If filled it goes into the comment thread and the resident can see it. The answer to "what was done" stays here.
requests.assignSectionHint: Changing the assignee does not rewind progress; an in-progress request keeps its status.
requests.commentsSectionHint: Internal notes are hidden from the resident but stay in the same chronological order.
requests.internalNoteHint: If checked, only management and assignees can see it.
requests.readOnlyNotice: You can view this request but you do not have permission to change it.
requests.drawerCreatedHint: The list has been updated. You can open another request or go to its detail.

maintenance.title: Maintenance calendar
maintenance.description: Legally required periodic inspections are listed with their regulatory reference. Reminders are sent 30, 15, 7 and 0 days before, and 3 days after.
maintenance.overdueAlertBody: Delaying mandatory periodic inspections risks administrative fines and loss of insurance cover. Schedule the overdue items as soon as possible.
maintenance.emptyDescription: Pick your equipment from the built-in library; intervals and regulatory references come prefilled.
maintenance.emptyStep1: Add the equipment present in your property from the list on the right.
maintenance.emptyStep2: Enter the last service date and let the system compute the next one.
maintenance.emptyStep3: Upload the invoice and report after each service.

reminder.overdue: The {label} service was due {days} days ago ({date}). Where legally required, this carries a fine risk.
reminder.upcoming: The {label} service is due in {days} days ({date}).

maintenance.newRecordDescription: Pick from the statutory template list or define your own interval. A template fills the fields; it does not lock them.
maintenance.editRecordDescription: Plan details and the "done" record are separate: the last service date is what inspectors ask for and must not change by accident while editing the plan.
maintenance.sectionWhatHint: What is serviced and where. Use the location to tell identical units apart.
maintenance.sectionScheduleHint: The first due date is entered manually; later ones follow from each "done" record.
maintenance.templatePickerHint: Selecting one fills the fields; you can change all of them afterwards.
maintenance.mandatoryNotice: This service is required by regulation.
maintenance.labelPlaceholder: e.g. Block A lift annual inspection
maintenance.locationHint: e.g. Block A plant room. Distinguishes identical equipment.
maintenance.intervalFieldHint: 365 for yearly, 180 for six-monthly, 30 for monthly.
maintenance.nextDueAtHint: Entered manually on the first record. Every "done" entry moves it forward afterwards.
maintenance.isActiveHint: Turning this off stops reminders but keeps the record and its history.
maintenance.notesHint: Service company, contract number, things to watch for.
maintenance.costHint: What this service cost the management.
maintenance.nextDueNotice: The next due date will be calculated as {days} days after the date performed — not after the planned date, so that a late service does not immediately look overdue again.
maintenance.documentUrlHint: Left empty, the previous report is kept.
maintenance.completionNoteHint: If filled, it is prepended to the record's notes as a dated line.
maintenance.neverDone: No service has been recorded yet.
maintenance.drawerCreatedHint: The schedule has been updated. You can define more services from the statutory list.

meters.title: Meters & consumption
meters.description: When a reading is entered, consumption is computed as (current − previous) × unit price and billed with the selected distribution formula.
meters.emptyDescription: Register the meters and enter monthly readings; upload a photo and OCR will suggest the value.
meters.emptyStep1: Define meter types and unit prices.
meters.newMeterDescription: Define a unit meter or a common-area meter. The installation reading is the starting point for the first period's consumption.
meters.editMeterDescription: The installation reading locks once a reading has been entered.
meters.sectionMeterHint: Type and location; a common-area meter is not tied to a unit.
meters.sectionBillingHint: The unit price turns consumption into an amount; the server calculates it.
meters.serialNoHint: The number on the meter. Tells the old one apart after a replacement.
meters.isCommonHint: When checked the unit selector closes: the same consumption cannot be charged both to shared costs and to a single unit.
meters.unitPriceHint: Per m³ or kWh. Amount = consumption × unit price.
meters.initialValueHint: What the meter showed when installed. The first period's consumption is calculated from it.
meters.initialValueLocked: A reading has been entered for this meter, so the installation reading can no longer be changed. If it could, the first period's consumption would change retroactively and an already-invoiced amount would silently become something else. If there is a data error, correct the reading instead.
meters.definedMetersHint: Meters with no readings appear here too; a missing reading is exactly what you are looking for.
meters.noMetersDescription: Readings cannot be entered before a meter exists. The "meter" formula in dues plans also depends on this data.
meters.batchDescription: Walk the building once and enter every meter in one go. Consumption, amount and anomaly flags are calculated on the server.
meters.batchNoMeters: You need to define meters first.
meters.batchNoEntries: No value was entered for any meter.
meters.batchInvalidHeader: The period and reading date must be valid.
meters.batchEmptyRowHint: A row you leave empty is skipped, not treated as zero. Entering zero for a meter you could not read makes two periods' consumption land on a single invoice next time.
meters.overwriteHint: When off, meters that already have a reading for the period are skipped — so resubmitting a round does not silently change history.
meters.drawerCreatedHint: The meter list has been updated. You can define meters for the other units too.

reservations.title: Common area reservations
reservations.description: Overlap protection is enforced at database level; a conflicting approved reservation cannot be created for the same resource.
reservations.emptyDescription: Residents can book a common area from the portal or over WhatsApp.
reservations.newResourceDescription: Define a bookable space: hall, gym, guest room… No reservation can be taken before a facility exists.
reservations.editResourceDescription: Rule changes apply only to new reservations; existing records keep their fee.
reservations.newReservationDescription: The fee is calculated from the facility's tariff and the duration. Overlap and opening-hour rules are enforced on the server.
reservations.decideDescription: Approve, reject or cancel. The reason you write on a rejection or cancellation is the only explanation the resident sees.
reservations.reasonHint: Shown to the resident and recorded in the audit log.
reservations.resourceSectionHint: The name and type residents will see on the booking screen.
reservations.capacityHint: Number of people. Enter 0 for no limit.
reservations.resourceActiveHint: Turning this off stops new reservations; existing ones are kept.
reservations.feeSectionHint: The amount is calculated from this tariff and the duration; the reservation form has no fee field.

feeUnitNotice.hour: A started hour counts in full: 2.5 hours is charged as 3. Fractional charging produced rounding leftovers in collection.
feeUnitNotice.day: A started day counts in full.
feeUnitNotice.booking: A single fee regardless of duration.

reservations.depositHint: A refundable security amount, tracked separately from the fee.
reservations.rulesSectionHint: These limits are enforced on the server; a reservation outside them is rejected.
reservations.maxHoursHint: How long a single reservation may last.
reservations.maxBookings: Maximum bookings per person per month
reservations.maxBookingsHint: How many times the same person may book within a month.
reservations.requiresApprovalHint: If turned off every request counts as approved immediately and the manager cannot take that slot back.
reservations.rulesTextHint: Shown to residents: cleaning responsibility, quiet hours, penalty terms.
reservations.bookingSectionHint: The selected facility's hours and maximum duration appear below.
reservations.resourceRules: Open {open}:00–{close}:00, at most {hours} hours per booking.
reservations.resourceNeedsApproval: The request will await approval first.
reservations.resourceAutoApproved: Reservations for this facility are approved immediately.
reservations.holderSectionHint: A reservation belongs to a person; when a tenant moves out the unit's past reservations do not transfer to the new resident.
reservations.unitHint: Optional; for per-unit usage in reports.
reservations.noResourcesYet: You need to define a facility first.
reservations.noResourcesDescription: A bookable space must exist before reservations can be taken.
reservations.drawerCreatedHint: The list has been updated. You can take another reservation.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Residential caretakers are exempt from income tax in Turkey; the gross-to-net difference comes mainly from social security contributions.
staff.emptyDescription: Add your caretaker, security or cleaning staff; salary and social security tracking is automatic.
staff.emptyStep2: Define the gross salary and contribution rates.
staff.severanceDescription: Estimates what would be payable when a staff member leaves. Nothing is saved.
staff.severanceOverride: Calculate with a different gross wage
staff.severanceOverrideHint: If left empty, the gross wage on the staff record is used. The record is not changed.
staff.severanceAppliesHint: An employee who resigns (outside the military service, retirement and marriage exceptions) is not entitled to severance pay.
staff.noticeAppliesHint: Not payable if the notice period was served or the contract was terminated for just cause (Labour Act art. 25/II).
staff.severanceFailed: Could not calculate. Check that you have permission and that the staff record is current.
staff.severanceBelowMinimum: Service is under one year, so no severance pay is due (Act 1475 art. 14). Notice pay is a separate entitlement and is included.
staff.severanceCeilingApplied: The gross wage exceeds the severance ceiling. {capped} was used as the annual base; the monthly excess of {excess} did not enter the severance calculation.
staff.severanceServiceSummary: {name} — {years} years {months} months of service, notice period {weeks} weeks.
staff.severanceEstimateNotice: This is an estimate, not a payroll run. Calculated with parameters effective {date}: severance ceiling {ceiling}, notice income tax rate {rate}%. Actual income tax depends on the employee's cumulative tax base; the ceiling is revised every six months.
staff.newStaffDescription: Add a caretaker, security, cleaning or technical staff record. National ID and IBAN are stored encrypted and never shown again.
staff.editStaffDescription: Leaving the ID and IBAN fields empty keeps the stored value.
staff.sectionPersonHint: Name and role are what appear on the roster.
staff.sectionIdentityHint: Both are stored encrypted and never returned by read endpoints; the screen only shows whether a value is on record. Leave empty to keep the current value.
staff.sectionEmploymentHint: Severance is derived from the start date, so getting it right matters.
staff.sectionPayrollHint: These fields record figures; they do not produce payroll.
staff.phoneHint: For emergencies and shift notices. Shown masked in the list.
staff.tcknHint: 11 digits. If one is on record the field appears empty — leave it empty to keep it.
staff.ibanHint: For salary payments. If one is on record the field appears empty.
staff.clearTcknHint: Leaving the field empty does not delete it; deleting is a separate decision.
staff.clearIbanHint: Leaving the field empty does not delete it; deleting is a separate decision.
staff.endedAtNotice: With an end date the record becomes inactive and drops out of the monthly cost total. Attendance, leave and assigned-asset history are kept.
staff.leaveNegative: Leave used exceeds the entitlement. Under Labour Act art. 53 the entitlement follows length of service: 1–5 years 14 days, 5–15 years 20 days, over 15 years 26 days (minimum).
staff.grossSalaryHint: Before social security and tax. Severance is calculated from this.
staff.netSalaryHint: Take-home amount. Not calculated — read it off the payroll and enter it.
staff.sgkPremiumHint: Counts toward the monthly cost total together with gross salary.
staff.advanceBalanceHint: Paid to the employee and not yet offset.
staff.payrollDisclaimer: Net salary and social security are recorded here, not calculated. Real payroll depends on the minimum living allowance, cumulative tax base and incentive reductions; a second calculation would contradict the accountant's payroll.
staff.drawerCreatedHint: The roster has been updated. You can add another or close the drawer.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Documents are shared according to permission level; identity documents should only be stored where strictly necessary.
documents.expiringBody: {count} documents expire within 30 days (insurance policy, contract or permit).
documents.emptyDescription: Upload contracts, permits, policies and minutes; you'll be reminded before they expire.

legal.title: Legal & enforcement
legal.description: Debts older than {days} days automatically appear on the candidate list. The collection score shows which case to attempt settlement on first.
legal.candidatesDescription: Units more than {days} days overdue with no payment
legal.legalNoticeBody: For common expense receivables the manager may file suit and start enforcement without a general assembly decision (Condominium Act art. 35). A statutory mortgage can be registered on the unit for unpaid common expenses (art. 22).
legal.emptyDescription: When a debt passes 90 days the system drafts a formal notice and starts the lawyer assignment flow.
legal.emptyStep3: Open a case from the candidate list.

kvkkPanel.title: Data protection
kvkkPanel.description: Requests must be answered within {days} days (KVKK art. 13).
kvkkPanel.overdueAlertTitle: There are overdue data protection requests
kvkkPanel.overdueAlertBody: Requests past their response deadline can lead to a complaint to the authority. Resolve them as a priority.
kvkkPanel.erasureTitle: What happens on an erasure request?
kvkkPanel.erasureDescription: Some records cannot be deleted due to legal obligations; those are anonymised and retained.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Records cannot be modified or deleted. Retention is {days} days (Law No. 5651).
audit.appendOnlyNote: This log is protected as append-only at database level: updates and deletes are blocked by triggers.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Summary for {period}. The monthly report is also emailed on the 5th of each month.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Property details, business rules and integrations.
settings.priceCapNote: On renewal the price increase is contractually capped at {pct}%. You keep a {days}-day unconditional refund right.
settings.readOnlyNotice: You can view the settings but you do not have permission to change them.
settings.propertyInfoHint: The building's official name and address. Used on the landing page, documents and notifications.
settings.addressLineHint: Street, number. This address appears on notices and documents.
settings.duesRulesHint: These settings directly affect debt generation; changes apply to future debts.
settings.dueDayHint: Day of the month the payment falls due. At most 28 — days 29–31 shift in short months and the due date would become an answer that varies by month.
settings.lateFeePctHint: Monthly rate applied to overdue debts.
settings.lateFeeEnabledHint: When off, overdue debts accrue no late fee; existing records are unchanged.
settings.lateFeeLegalNotice: Condominium Act art. 20 does not permit a late fee above 5% per month, so the field is capped. Changes apply only to future calculations; past debts are not recomputed.
settings.invoiceInfoHint: Used on invoices issued to the management and on receipts.
settings.invoiceTaxNumberHint: A 10-digit tax number or an 11-digit national ID.
settings.kvkkSectionHint: The data controller's contact point and the sending-consent rule.
settings.kvkkContactEmailHint: Residents' data requests are routed here. If empty, no address appears in the privacy notice.
settings.whatsappOptInRequiredHint: When on, WhatsApp only goes to residents who consented. Turning it off moves the compliance responsibility to the management.
settings.integrationsHint: This list shows the real connection state: whether credentials exist, which scope they come from, and when the last message was sent.
settings.lastSuccessAt: Last sent {date} · {count} messages in the last 30 days

migration.title: Data import
migration.description: Upload the export file from your current management software. Columns are detected automatically and you see a preview before saving.
migration.uploadDescription: Export file in CSV format (max 5 MB).
migration.fileHint: A header row is required (unit no., block, balance, etc.).
migration.confirmFileLabel: Select the same file again to confirm
migration.afterImportHint: You can review the unit list and complete the land share details.
migration.fileMissing: File not found, please upload it again.
migration.completed: Import complete: {units} units, {blocks} blocks, {debts} carried-over balances.

issue.noDataRows: No data rows found in the file.
issue.missingUnitColumn: No unit number column could be found.
issue.emptyUnitNumber: Unit number is empty, the row was skipped.
issue.duplicateUnit: Unit {number} appears more than once in the file.
issue.landShareTooLarge: Land share looks too large ({value}); check whether it is a percentage or per mille.

certificate.title: Debt status certificate
certificate.description: Produce the certificate needed for a mortgage, title transfer or official filing in seconds. It can be verified online with its code.
certificate.newDescription: The certificate reflects the debt status at the time of request.
certificate.kepHint: If provided, the certificate is also delivered officially by registered electronic mail.
certificate.verifyHintBody: The receiving institution can confirm authenticity at {url} by entering the certificate number and verification code.
certificate.createdClear: The certificate of no outstanding debt was created.
certificate.createdOutstanding: The debt status certificate was created (there is outstanding debt).
certificate.emptyDescription: Residents can request one from the portal or by writing “belge” on WhatsApp.
certificate.emptyStep2: The system checks the debt status.
certificate.emptyStep3: The PDF is produced instantly, optionally sent by registered email.

verify.title: Certificate verification
verify.description: Enter the certificate number and verification code to confirm authenticity.
verify.resultClear: There was no outstanding debt on the stated date.
verify.resultOutstanding: There was {amount} of outstanding debt on the stated date.
verify.validNote: The certificate reflects the debt status on its issue date. New accruals may have been created since.
verify.invalidTitle: The certificate could not be verified
verify.invalidBody: No record matches the certificate number and verification code entered.

resident.title: Resident portal
resident.transparencyNote: The payment screen shows the platform fee and the bank commission separately; there are no hidden deductions.
resident.noDebtBody: If you wish, you can generate a certificate of no outstanding debt instantly.
resident.changeHistoryDescription: Every change to your amount appears here and cannot be deleted.
resident.noUnitDescription: Once your manager links you to a unit, your balance and payment details will appear here.
resident.overdueBody: A balance of {amount} is past due. Late fees continue to accrue.

payment.feeByManagement: The bank commission is covered by the property management; the amount you pay is credited to your balance in full.
payment.feeByResident: The platform service fee and bank commission have been added to the debt amount.
payment.securityNote: 3D Secure verification is mandatory for all payments. Your card details are never stored by us; the payment page is served by a licensed payment institution.

admin.title: Platform administration
admin.overdueKvkkBody: {count} requests are past their response deadline. This creates a regulatory complaint risk.
admin.impersonationBody: When a session is opened on behalf of a user, every action is separately written to the audit log and the user is notified.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: An unexpected error occurred while loading this section. Retrying usually resolves it; if it persists, share the reference code with support.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The record may have been deleted, or the address is incorrect.

inventory.title: Asset Register
inventory.description: Record of items and equipment in common areas. The manager accounts for this list at handover (Condominium Act art. 34).
inventory.tableHint: Items that leave are not deleted, their status changes; the register is a history.
inventory.codeHint: The number on the label. Must be unique within the site.
inventory.name: Name
inventory.locationHint: Boiler room, block A entrance, shelter…
inventory.quantityHint: Several identical items can be kept on one row.
inventory.purchasePriceHint: Price per unit. Depreciation is not calculated.
inventory.responsibleHint: If the staff record is deleted the assignment clears; the item remains.
inventory.selectionEmpty: Select at least one item first.
inventory.statValueHint: Only items in use or in repair.
inventory.statLostHint: Items that must be accounted for at handover.
inventory.emptyDescription: Start by recording items in common areas; this list is the basis at handover.
inventory.emptyStep1: Enter items such as fire extinguishers, generators and garden equipment.
inventory.emptyStep2: Give each item an asset number and label it.
inventory.emptyStep3: At the year-end count, mark missing items as “Lost” in bulk.

decisionBook.title: Decision Book
decisionBook.description: Continuously numbered, site-wide record of general assembly and management decisions.
decisionBook.legalNotice: Condominium Act art. 32: decisions are written into the book with a date and sequence number and may be viewed by every owner. A decision written into the book cannot be changed — a correcting decision is written instead.
decisionBook.tableHint: Newest first. Numbers run continuously across the whole site.
decisionBook.correctedBy: This decision was corrected by decision {no}; read that one for the current ruling.
decisionBook.correctionNotice: This entry will correct decision {no}. The old decision stays in the book; the two are read together.
decisionBook.immutableNotice: A decision written into the book cannot be changed afterwards. Check the text before saving.
decisionBook.subject: Agenda item
decisionBook.bodyHint: Write the full text; line breaks are preserved.
decisionBook.meetingHint: Leave empty for decisions taken without a meeting.
decisionBook.votesHint: Fractional values are allowed for land-share weighted voting.
decisionBook.bookPageNoHint: Page number in the notarised book, if any.
decisionBook.passedHint: If switched off the decision is recorded as rejected.
decisionBook.statCorrectedHint: Decisions later corrected by another decision.
decisionBook.emptyDescription: Record general assembly and management decisions here.
decisionBook.emptyStep1: Write meeting decisions separately for each agenda item.
decisionBook.emptyStep2: Also record unanimous decisions taken without a meeting (art. 32).
decisionBook.emptyStep3: Enter the page number when you transcribe it into the notarised book.
decisionBook.meetingsLink: For meeting agendas and attendance see the <link>Meetings</link> screen.

myDebts.title: My Debts
myDebts.description: Balance breakdown and adjustments for your unit.
myDebts.emptyDescription: There is no balance assigned to your unit.
myDebts.changesDescription: Every adjustment to your balance appears here and cannot be deleted.

myPayments.title: My Payments
myPayments.description: Payment history and receipt numbers for your unit.
myPayments.emptyDescription: You have no recorded payments yet.

myRequests.title: My Requests
myRequests.description: Issues and requests you have submitted.
myRequests.newDescription: Describe the issue clearly — management resolves it faster.
myRequests.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Lift stops on the 3rd floor
myRequests.priorityHint: Management raises the priority itself in emergencies.
myRequests.descriptionHint: Where, when and how it happened speeds things up.
myRequests.emptyDescription: Report an issue or request from here whenever you need to.
myRequests.conversationHint: Your conversation with management about this request.
myRequests.closedHint: This request is closed. Open a new one for a new issue.

myMessages.title: My Messages
myMessages.emptyDescription: Send your first message to management below.
myMessages.placeholder: What would you like to tell management?

myProfile.title: My Details
myProfile.description: Your recorded details and unit relationships.
myProfile.emailHint: Notifications and receipts are sent to this address.
myProfile.maskedHint: Phone and national ID are masked for security. Tell your manager if anything is wrong.

managementInfo.title: Management Info
managementInfo.description: Who to contact, how, and where to pay dues.
managementInfo.bankDescription: You can make your payments to these accounts.
managementInfo.ibanMaskedHint: The IBAN is masked for security. Ask your manager for the full number.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Summary of the {count} properties you manage. Those needing attention come first.
portfolio.emptyDescription: Properties appear here once you are a member of one.
portfolio.footnote: The list is built from {user}'s memberships.
